question: For each department, list the department name, the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in each subject offered in the fall term with more than 0 enrolled students, the employee type, the number of people, the minimum MIT ID, and the number of unique office locations for graduate students in that department. Do not return any rounded answers.

WITH fall_enrollment AS (
    SELECT
        sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
        sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
    FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos
    WHERE sos.TERM_CODE LIKE '%FA'
      AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0
),
dept_enrollment_stats AS (
    SELECT
        fe.OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
        AVG(fe.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled,
        VAR_SAMP(fe.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_enrolled
    FROM fall_enrollment fe
    GROUP BY fe.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
),
grad_student_stats AS (
    SELECT
        msd.DEPARTMENT,
        COUNT(*) AS number_of_people,
        MIN(sp.MIT_ID) AS min_mit_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT msd.OFFICE_LOCATION) AS unique_office_locations
    FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
    JOIN SE_PERSON sp ON msd.FULL_NAME = sp.FULL_NAME
    WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G'
    GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT
)
SELECT
    sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    des.avg_enrolled,
    des.variance_enrolled,
    'Graduate Student' AS employee_type,
    gss.number_of_people,
    gss.min_mit_id,
    gss.unique_office_locations
FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
JOIN dept_enrollment_stats des ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = des.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
LEFT JOIN grad_student_stats gss ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = gss.DEPARTMENT
